research.title: Tree of Thoughts with CodeAct Pattern — Thesis
points: Built a Tree-of-Thoughts framework where LLMs generate and execute Python code at each search step instead of free-form text — making reasoning verifiable via sandbox execution
Achieved 89% accuracy on the Game of 24 task (100-puzzle test set) using DeepSeek as teacher and Gemma 4 31B, averaging 45 API calls per puzzle
Built a Dead-End Memory module that skips 30–80% of explored states by accumulating failure patterns across the search tree
Implemented two-level pruning: static heuristics at depth 1, dynamic failure-pattern injection into LLM proposals at depth ≥ 2
Ran a full distillation pipeline: generated 900 annotated reasoning traces, converted them to backtracking examples, and fine-tuned SmolLM-360M — zero API calls at inference
Student model (v2) achieved 100% arithmetic accuracy per step after backtracking augmentation with variable dead-end depths and multi-level targets
Fixed a format compliance gap in Gemma 4 31B (0% one-word compliance) via last-line extraction — recovered 100% label accuracy without changing the model
Documented failure modes: beam selection bugs, extraction inconsistencies, and ground truth labelling errors in the eval suite
research.headline: 89% Game of 24 · 30–80% states skipped · 0 API calls at inference

projects.title: BUCC Event Registration System — Full-Stack Event Platform
points: Production event registration platform for the BRAC University Computer Club — separate Next.js 16 frontend and NestJS backend, deployed on Vercel

NestJS backend with JWT auth, email verification codes, password reset flow, and three roles (Attendee, Organizer, Admin) with route-level guards — events CRUD, registrations, tickets, and QR check-in endpoints

Next.js 16 frontend using the App Router with Cache Components and Partial Prerendering — public pages prerender as static shells while auth-dependent content streams in dynamically behind Suspense boundaries
Server-side auth guards on /dashboard and /admin via next/headers cookie forwarding — unauthenticated requests redirect to /organizer/log-in, admin routes require ADMIN role and redirect otherwise

API proxy pattern: browser /api/* requests rewrite to the backend, while server components call the backend directly using API_URL with the session cookie forwarded — keeps the backend URL out of client bundles

Homepage with a full-screen autoplay event carousel (Embla), an About section that's a desktop click-to-reveal image grid and a mobile tap-to-expand accordion, impact stats, activities, and a member photo carousel

Event listing with URL-driven category filter (Workshop/Hackathon/Talk/Social) and an availability chip computed on the frontend — Open / Almost Full / Full / Closed derived from capacity, spotsLeft, and endsAt
Registration form with Zod validation (name, email, phone) that POSTs to the backend and returns a ticket page with a generated QR code
Ticket page rendering QR codes via the qrcode library with status states (Confirmed / Checked In / Cancelled), designed to be scanned at the door
Organizer dashboard: create/edit events with draft→published lifecycle, publish/unpublish/cancel actions, and a registrations table with live search and CSV export
Check-in page with a camera-based QR scanner (qr-scanner) plus a manual name/email search fallback — green/red result states for checked-in vs already-scanned vs invalid
Admin panel hidden behind a configurable route (sys/panel, noindex) with user management and cross-organizer event cancellation
Tailwind CSS 4 with Turbopack, a custom design token system (ink/paper/lime/stone), accessible focus styles, scroll-driven animations, and full mobile-first responsive layouts
Every page sets a metadata title that composes with a root '%s | BUCC' template, plus a custom black-and-white SVG favicon matching the navbar logo

projects.title: 404 Project Not Found — Task Manager & Image Annotator
points: Full-stack SaaS-style productivity app with two modules: a Kanban task manager and a polygon image annotation tool
Django REST Framework backend with JWT auth — login, protected routes, per-user data isolation across all endpoints
Task module: Kanban board with drag-and-drop columns (To Do / In Progress / Done) using @dnd-kit, date-filtered task views, priority badges, and real-time status PATCH updates
Annotation module: SVG-overlay polygon drawing on uploaded images — percentage-based coordinates for resolution independence, label modal, per-annotation color coding
Images stored as Base64 in SQLite to work on Vercel's ephemeral serverless filesystem — no external storage service needed
Config-driven UI architecture: columns, priorities, tools, and nav all rendered from TypeScript config files — zero hardcoded JSX duplication
8 reusable UI components (Button, Input, Card, Badge, Modal, EmptyState, LoadingState, PageHeader) used consistently across all pages
Deployed on Vercel (frontend) with Django backend via Vercel serverless — axios interceptors handle JWT attachment and 401 redirects automatically
